top_signals.title: Oil prices jump as Iran steps up tanker attacks, hurricane threatens U.S. Gulf production
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump and his national security team have talked about possibly restarting large-scale U.S. military operations in Iran, according to reports.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitwise CEO says ‘tragic’ Dogecoin ETF failure shows gap between ETF buyers and crypto-app users
top_signals.summary: Alongside its recent spot NEAR ETF launch, Bitwise is prioritizing AI and intends to do more in that area.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Maextro Pledges Brake Redesign After Stock Slides on Test Report
top_signals.summary: Anhui Jianghuai Automobile Group Corp Ltd. shares fell by the daily limit in Shanghai after three vehicles from its flagship luxury brand were depicted in a media test with broken brake-pedal supports, prompting the automaker to pledge a redesign of the component and offer a free upgrade to owners.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Longer-Dated US Bonds Rise Ahead of $22 Billion 30-Year Sale
top_signals.summary: Longer-dated US Treasuries rose as investors readied for a $22 billion auction of 30-year debt, which stands to test demand as yields linger near multi-decade highs.
